nonblockingObservations.notes: A low-alpha blue arc retained near the feet is visible in raw transparent preview tooling. On normal alpha composition its contribution is at most one 8bit channel level. It has no alpha>12 contour, does not cut the figure, and is not a limb. No broad alpha cleanup or artwork mutation was performed.

limitations: Single individual project portrait rather than a multi-angle design sheet; far temple, rear garment construction, iris microdetail and hidden device mechanics cannot be certified exactly.

Anatomical-left temple is shaved/implanted; anatomical-right has long turquoise hair. Run05–08 preserve three-quarter heads with both eyes, so seeing the far-left temple at imageRIGHT is not itself an inversion. No true right-profile near-temple swap was established in these16cells.
Five digits are checked where clearly exposed; naturally hidden or tiny fingers are not falsely counted as missing.
Corrected10 has a separately generated render and some natural stylized size/detail variation; no gross size jump established against the full set, but exact skeletal scaling is not certified.
Old source/attempts remain the producer responsibility; this reviewer did not modify portraits, natives, candidate pixels, prior receipts or runtime registries.
No automatic or perfect1:1 visual certification. Runtime integration remains with root.
